title: filelock: SoftFileLock evicts a fresh lock file whose watched age another local user's pre-dated file passed on…
description: A vulnerability in filelock versions 4.1.0 through 4.2.0 allows a local unprivileged user to cause a lock file eviction by exploiting inode reuse and coarse clock timestamp manipulation on ext4 or overlayfs filesystems. This results in two processes of the lock owner entering a critical section simultaneously, causing a high integrity impact without affecting confidentiality or availability.
